entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""May I have a quick word with you?""
entries.dialogueText: "May I have a quick word with you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, Uncle.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Uncle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there something wrong?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is there something wrong?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not now, Hugo.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not now, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite my words he leaned in and k..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite my words he leaned in and kept speaking.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You tell me, Romus...""
entries.dialogueText: "You tell me, Romus..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You've published the evidence ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've published the evidence everywhere. Lespian intelligence planted the bomb in Zille. As I suspected from the beginning, my son had nothing to do with it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""So I must ask you. When will Ricar..."
entries.dialogueText: "So I must ask you. When will Ricardus be freed?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I will order his rele..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I will order his release immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are still not completely sure t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are still not completely sure that he's innocent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He will be freed when I say he wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "He will be freed when I say he will be freed. You are in no position to make demands, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't understand, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're not sure? Even after findin..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're not sure? Even after finding indisputable proof that Lespia was the true culprit?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even if Rico were not my son, it d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if Rico were not my son, it does us no good to have a member of House Toras in prison. An innocent one at that..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His face turned bitter."
entries.dialogueText: His face turned bitter.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. From the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. From the bottom of my heart."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It does us no good to have a membe..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does us no good to have a member of House Toras in prison. An innocent one, at that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He and Su Omina may have still pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and Su Omina may have still played some role. We need to investigate this further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He was not involved in the Zille b..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was not involved in the Zille bombing. But he may be guilty of other crimes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Rico would never collaborate with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico would never collaborate with Lespia, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry. But I can't release yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. But I can't release your son."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He shall only walk free once he ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "He shall only walk free once he has been completely cleared of all wrongdoing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are right. He will be freed im..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right. He will be freed immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Be careful with what you're about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful with what you're about to say, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was losing control of the volume..."
entries.dialogueText: He was losing control of the volume of his voice. He quickly stopped himself.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We will talk later. The council is..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will talk later. The council is waiting for us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He swiftly stepped in front of me a..."
entries.dialogueText: He swiftly stepped in front of me and motioned towards the door.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Come now. The council is waiting f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now. The council is waiting for us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle heaved a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle heaved a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I assure you that he is not. And b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you that he is not. And besides, suspicions alone do not justify his detention."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will be honest with you. Rico is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be honest with you. Rico is a necessary sacrifice that must be made in order for Zille to be returned."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What?!""
entries.dialogueText: "What?!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We have proven to the world that L..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have proven to the world that Lespia was the true culprit. If Wiktor Smolak doesn't return Zille in the face of that proof, the Alliance of Nations will surely force him to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. If it makes you happy, I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. If it makes you happy, I will order his release."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is a private matter between m..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a private matter between myself and President Smolak. Do not attempt to intervene in it."
